text:
maya: Pushed an updated prototype for the Private/VPC setup wizard — focused on the networking prereq step. PTAL: https://figma.redwood.in/priv-wizard/net-check. Key ideas: inline network tester, clearer CIDR helper, assistive copy for missing egress, and keyboard/focus flow notes. Thoughts?

liam: Saw it — nice direction. Quick Q: the inline tester, will it require credentials? we should avoid any auth prompts in-browser.

maya: No creds. It only does outbound checks (simple TCP to 443/80 and a fetch to a small resource on our CDN). Results are PASS/WARN/FAIL. If FAIL we offer explicit next steps and a KB link.

sofia: Copy nit: "Public egress required" reads scary to non-networks folks. Suggest: "Outgoing internet access is required to download models. You can restrict access to our download domains."

alex: +1 to sofia. Also accessibility: add an aria-live region to announce test start/completion and the PASS/WARN/FAIL result. Keyboard: Enter on the Run button should start test but keep focus in the results area, not jump to top.

design-bot: Accessibility checklist for this flow: 1) aria-live for test status. 2) Visible focus ring on all interactive controls. 3) Ensure tab order: CIDR helper -> Run test -> Results list -> Continue. 4) Status badges meet contrast >= 4.5:1.

maya: For result microcopy I drafted brief lines: PASS: "Connection OK — downloads allowed." WARN: "Partial connectivity — some hosts may be blocked." FAIL: "No outbound access detected." Open to wording changes.

liam: Love brevity. For FAIL include a link to KB: "No outbound access detected. See https://help.redwood.ai/vpc-egress for firewall rules and examples."

sofia: UX suggestion: add a "Skip network checks" affordance for infra-driven installs. Show a modal confirmation: "Skipping checks may cause deployment failures. Proceed?" Also a checkbox: "My infra team will handle networking."

qa-anna: QA notes: please add tests for long-running checks (timeouts), flaky DNS, and an explicit "Cancel test" button. When canceled, screenreader should hear: "Network test canceled." Also test keyboard-only flows and magnifier scaling.

maya: Will add Cancel and timeout states. Updated copy proposals: PASS: "Connection detected — downloads permitted." WARN: "Limited connectivity — some domains may be blocked." FAIL: "Outbound connectivity not detected. Follow steps to open egress to our model download domains."

alex: Also include an expandable code snippet for ops with example iptables/nft rules and a copy button. e.g.: ```iptables -A OUTPUT -d dl.redwood.ai -j ACCEPT```

liam: One more: point doc link to our docs site path rather than the short help domain: "/docs/private/setup/network-egress" so it syncs with current nav.

maya: Cool — I'll update the Figma with the copy/aria changes, add the iptables code block, and post the a11y checklist for QA. Will also add a small inline tooltip for CIDR entry with example: "172.31.0.0/16 — no host bits". Thanks team :heart:
